changed: Auth placement and the live sandbox check now come from the admitted plugins' manifest connection sections instead of server tables keyed by the odoo19 id (R-1, ADR 0012 item 1, ADR 0026). New e_agent.sdk.connection types the section (auth methods with header placement, test_connection probe name). PluginRegistry validates it at admission, before plugin code loads, refusing an unknown placement, method type, key or a missing prefix with STARTUP_REJECTED, and records connection_specs, auth_placements and per-plugin executors. Bootstrap gains admit_plugins(); CredentialService reads the registry's placements by reference; _check_sandbox refuses a live provider (an enabled plugin used by a profile connection) whose manifest names no probe, and probes each provider through its own executor. AUTH_PLACEMENT and LIVE_PROVIDERS_WITH_SANDBOX are gone; the Odoo placement (Authorization, 'bearer ') and the Odoo target comparison are unchanged.
open_items: An integration without a connection section (the hand-wired fixture-erp) still gets CredentialService's api_key fallback with AuthContext.apply's 'Authorization: Bearer' defaults; removing that fallback is a follow-up, not widened here

The sandbox target comparison (database, company_id, bridge_version, server_version 19.0) is still Odoo-shaped in bootstrap; a manifest-declared expectation map would change the odoo19 manifest digest and is left for the task that re-pins (1d.10/1d.12) or a later ADR
Live check against odoo19-learning not run in this task (level 4 belongs to 1d.12); unit tests cover the probe with a stand-in executor and the real packaged Odoo connection section
check_wheels.py was run by hand on 7d6188e and passed; it is not part of the full gate set

rulings.ruling: A manifest with more than one auth method is refused at admission, because connections carry no auth-method id and choosing one would be a default
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a provider offering several methods cannot be admitted until connections gain a method reference (ADR 0013 admin work); relax the validator then

rulings.ruling: AuthMethod.type is limited to api_key and none, and placement to header, matching what AuthContext.apply implements
rulings.cost_if_wrong: OAuth or query placement providers are refused until their mechanics land (ADR 0013); extend the Literal with the implementation

rulings.ruling: The connection section stays an untyped dict on PluginManifest and is validated at admission, so an installed but not enabled plugin with a bad section never breaks discovery
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a malformed section is noticed only when the plugin is enabled; if discovery-time validation is wanted, type PluginManifest.connection later

rulings.ruling: test_connection must be a public lower-case identifier, since bootstrap calls it with getattr on the plugin's executor
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a provider with a differently named probe must rename it; low

rulings.ruling: The plan's expected red for the second-provider test (KeyError from AUTH_PLACEMENT) did not occur: CredentialService fell back to 'Authorization: Bearer'. The test asserts an X-Api-Key header with an empty prefix, which failed for that reason before the change
rulings.cost_if_wrong: none; the test is stronger than planned

rulings.ruling: Contract scope added src/e_agent/kernel/credentials.py (keep the placement mapping by reference) and bootstrap.admit_plugins() as a test seam; neither is in the plan's file list
rulings.cost_if_wrong: small; the seam can be folded back into build_runtime
